init.description: Power switch, health scoring thresholds, and optional stratum pool changes (requires miner reachable).

health_thresholds.name: Miner health thresholds
health_thresholds.description: Auto profile picks thresholds by manufacturer and model (starting recommendations — verify for your firmware). Number fields below apply only when profile is Custom.

data_description.health_profile: Auto uses built-in profiles by make/model. Generic uses universal defaults. Custom uses the numbers below.
data_description.temp_chip_warn_c: Chip junction temperature: partial score reduction starts here. Meaning varies by firmware and hardware.
data_description.temp_chip_high_c: Chip temperature critical: triggers High temperature and Attention required.
data_description.temp_board_warn_c: PCB/board temperature warning — usually lower than chip limits.
data_description.hashrate_low_ratio: Actual hashrate vs ideal from the miner (0.85 = 85%). Evaluated only while mining.
data_description.chip_low_percent: Minimum effective chips per board (%). Evaluated only while mining.
data_description.reject_rate_high_pct: Pool reject rate (%) above which scoring penalizes the miner.
data_description.share_stale_seconds: No accepted share for this long while mining reduces the score.
data_description.pool_action: Leave unchanged, replace the primary slot, or add a backup (max 3 pools).
data_description.pool_password: Leave empty if the pool does not require a password.
